title: On Debiasing Text Embeddings Through Context Injection

bias_targets.methodology: Geometrical bias identification (projecting occupation embeddings onto a gender concept subspace), Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT) measuring cosine similarity between gender terms and occupations, and evaluating the bias impact on a downstream top-k document retrieval task.

Geometrical bias identification and Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT) to measure the association and cosine similarity between age-related target words (e.g., old, young) and specific character trait attributes.

Geometrical bias identification and Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT) to evaluate the association and cosine similarity between wealth-related target words (e.g., poverty, wealth) and various ethnicity attributes.
